items.summary: Restore the TrailerModal component in frontend/src/components/TrailerModal.tsx so that clicking 'Watch Trailer' on any MediaCard opens a visible modal dialog with a YouTube iframe player

Implement trailer fetching logic in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts (or a dedicated hook) that queries the TMDB API for trailer/video data given a media item's type and ID, with proper error handling for rate limits, timeouts, and missing trailers
Update MediaCard component in frontend/src/components/MediaCard.tsx to trigger the TrailerModal when the user clicks 'Watch Trailer', passing the media item's type and ID to the modal

Ensure the TrailerModal displays explicit UI states for loading (spinner or skeleton), no trailer available (user-friendly message), and fetch errors (error message with 'Try Again' button that re-fetches)
Configure the TrailerModal's Radix/Shadcn Dialog component with a z-index high enough to render above all other page content, preventing the modal from being visually hidden in production

Manage TrailerModal open/close and iframe lifecycle state transitions so the modal reliably re-fetches and renders trailers when reopened, avoiding stale state that could leave the modal effectively invisible or the iframe failing to load
